rtl_rules.direction: Use `dir='rtl'` on the root element for Arabic mode.
mirroring: Flip chevrons and directional arrows (left arrow becomes right arrow in RTL).
Mirror margin/padding: Use `ms-` (margin-start) and `me-` (margin-end) instead of `ml-` and `mr-`.
Align text: `text-right` is default in RTL, `text-left` for English code snippets.
Input fields: Text input direction should align with the active language.
rtl_rules.icons: Use generic icons that don't need flipping (e.g., search, settings). Flip directional icons like 'ArrowRight' to point left in RTL.

Card.style: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-lg border border-border/50 shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-glow group

CourseCard.overlay: group-hover:opacity-100 opacity-0 transition-opacity bg-black/60 absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center
CourseCard.badge: absolute top-3 right-3 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded border border-white/10

VideoPlayer.container: relative aspect-video bg-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 shadow-2xl
VideoPlayer.controls: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 to-transparent p-4

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SYSTEM SETUP: Ensure `tailwind.config.js` includes the custom colors (primary: #7079F7).
2. RTL CONFIG: Create a `LanguageContext` or similar to toggle `dir='rtl'` on the `<html>` or `<body>` tag. Default to RTL for Arabic.
3. FONTS: Import 'Cairo' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts. Apply 'font-cairo' to body when language is Arabic.
4. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn/UI components but override default radius to 'rounded-md' or 'rounded-lg'. Do not use 'rounded-xl' unless it's a large container.
5. DARK MODE: Force dark mode by default. Add 'dark' class to html/body. Do not rely on system preference initially.
6. ICONS: Use `lucide-react`. Ensure icons are flipped in RTL where necessary (e.g., `ArrowRight` becomes `ArrowLeft`).
7. LAYOUT: For the Course Viewer, use a 'Cinema' layout: Darkest background, video takes focus, sidebar for curriculum is collapsible.
8. NO AUTH: Use `localStorage` to persist 'completed_lessons' and 'quiz_results'. Key it by course ID.
9. ADMIN: Create a simple 'secret code' input for Admin access. Do not build full auth.
10. DATA: Mock the YouTube data structure initially (Title, VideoID, Thumbnail, Description).
11. UNIVERSAL RULES: Follow the <UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT> in the system prompt.

do_not: Do NOT use generic gradients like blue-to-purple without noise/texture.
Do NOT center text on heavy reading pages (course descriptions).
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) for cards; use #121212 or #18181b.
Do NOT forget empty states (No courses found, No progress yet).
must_do: MUST use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
MUST ensure adequate contrast ratio (4.5:1) for text.
MUST support keyboard navigation for all interactive elements.
MUST use lazy loading for YouTube iframes.
